svg.title: NS1 — Original dual-application stable/canary architecture diagram
svg.desc: Faithful editable vector recreation of the user-supplied first architecture image showing Gateway, VirtualService, APP A and APP B, stable/canary Frontend, Backend and CRUD Rollout columns.
